english.note: This is the neutral, all-purpose rendering for a male romantic partner.
Use this specifically for a male romantic partner or boyfriend.

examples.english: My boyfriend is coming to pick me up tonight.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 naam4 pang4 jau5 gam1 maan5 lei4 zip3 ngo5

examples.english: The man I’m dating is going to the movies with me tomorrow.
examples.traditional: 我男朋友聽日同我睇戲。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 naam4 pang4 jau5 ting1 jat6 tung4 ngo5 tai2 hei3
